description: OpenCode effort (variant) ids every layer must treat alike: hgs catalog projection (src/state/opencode/catalog.rs safe_id with the 40-byte bound), Rust connector, relay, desktop, Android and iOS. An id is valid when it is non-empty, at most 40 UTF-8 bytes, and contains no whitespace, no control character and no '/'. Membership in the model's effort_options stays authoritative; this list only fixes the shape rule.
